jobs.title: Research Engineer, Machine Learning
jobs.description: About Boltz Boltz is a public benefit company building the next generation of AI-powered molecular modeling tools to make biology programmable and accelerate drug discovery, while keeping frontier capabilities broadly accessible. Boltz was founded by former MIT scientists who created Boltz-1, the first fully commercially available open-source model to approach AlphaFold 3-level accuracy in predicting the 3D structure of biomolecular complexes. We focus on two things: Foundation models. Our open models, Boltz-1, Boltz-2 and BoltzGen, are trusted by 100,000+ scientists across biotech and academia, and used in programs at every Top 20 pharma as well as leading agrichemical and industrial research organizations. Our latest proprietary foundation models power our products and the custom models we build with partners. Boltz Lab and the Boltz API. Our products run our latest models, design pipelines (BoltzMol for small molecules, BoltzProt for protein design) and agents as reliable, production-grade tools built around real chemistry and biology workflows. Teams start from a target and a hypothesis, then generate, evaluate, and rank candidate molecules in Boltz Lab, run our models from their own code and agents through the Boltz API, or deploy them inside their own environment. The two feed each other: our open releases earn scientific credibility and community insight, and our products turn our full range of models into real impact for partners including Pfizer, Takeda, GSK, Bristol Myers Squibb and DSM-Firmenich. You can read more about our mission, research and product vision in our manifesto . About the role As a Research Engineer (ML), you will push the scale and efficiency of model training at Boltz, and work with researchers to decide where systems work will have the most research impact. jobs.title: Data Scientist, Trust & Safety
jobs.description: Brief info about Vinted  Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we re looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission: Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life. Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces. Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members. Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania s first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we ve grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.  Information about the position  You’ll join the Detection subdomain within Trust & Safety, whose mission is to protect the Vinted community by identifying harmful content and activities. We build detection capabilities that enable timely prevention and moderation, reducing members’ exposure to harm, while minimising disruption to legitimate members. You’ll develop and improve machine learning models that identify harmful listings and suspicious behaviour across the marketplace, while minimising friction on legitimate members. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Studytube maakt professionele ontwikkeling toegankelijk. Achter het platform zit een groeiende stroom leerdata. Die moet klanten, de business en de AI-features die we bouwen écht verder helpen. Daar zoeken we een Data Engineer voor die de datalaag bezit. De rol Je komt in een klein datateam binnen Product & Tech en rapporteert aan de Head of Engineering. Je werk bedient twee takken. Business: rapportages voor commerce, management en investeerders. Product: de inzichten die klanten in het platform zien, zoals voortgang en budget. Collega’s bouwen de dashboards, jij zorgt dat de data eronder klopt en meebeweegt met het product. Je werkt dagelijks samen met een businessanalist en een productanalist, die ook met Looker en dbt werkt. Er komt nog een analist bij. Een ervaren data engineer sluit één dag per week aan en een Data Lead staat op de planning. Wat je doet Je bent eigenaar van het Snowflake-platform: rollen en rechten, warehouse sizing en provisioning, tasks en kosten. Je beheert GitHub voor het dataplatform: branches, environments en automatisering met GitHub Actions. Je neemt Databricks, opgezet voor een high-security omgeving, over van een externe partij en bereidt de migratie van Snowflake naar Databricks voor, gepland voor volgend jaar. Je bouwt pipelines die incrementeel, idempotent, getest en gedocumenteerd zijn, en ontsluit bronnen via Fivetran of custom connectors. Je zorgt dat dbt Cloud betrouwbaar draait: afhankelijkheden, scheduling en failure handling. Je bewaakt freshness, volume en schema drift, en zoekt de root cause als iets breekt. Je ruimt de architectuur op, maakt het platform uitbreidbaar en bouwt GDPR-bewust: toegang, retentie en verwijdering zitten in het ontwerp. Je legt het fundament voor metrics waar sales, marketing en product op sturen, in plaats van handmatige Excels. Wie je bent Je hebt 3 tot 6 jaar productie-ervaring als data engineer. Je hebt de valkuilen al eens gezien en levert zonder platformteam achter je een geteste, gemonitor

With an exclusive focus on Artificial Intelligence and Big Data, Addepto helps organizations unlock the full potential of their data through systems designed for measurable business impact and long-term growth. The company's work extends beyond client engagements. Drawing from real-world challenges and insights, Addepto has developed its own product - ContextClue - and actively contributes open-source solutions to the AI community. This commitment to transforming practical experience into scalable innovation has earned Addepto recognition by Forbes as one of the top 10 AI consulting companies worldwide . As part of KMS Technology , a US-based global technology group, Addepto combines deep AI specialization with enterprise-scale delivery capabilitiesâenabling the partnership to move clients from AI experimentation to production impact, securely and at scale. We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer with strong skills in GCP, Snowflake, dbt, Python, SQL, and Data Analytics to join our team. You will work on international data engineering and analytics projects, focusing on building scalable data solutions, modernizing data warehouses, and supporting data-driven business decisions. CRM Data Integration â developing and optimizing data models to support CRM migrations and integrations (e.g., HubSpot).
